A '''moon''' with a stormy [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and [[Water/Legends|seas]] on its surface<ref name="Biogenesis" /> was one of the eighteen natural [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kiskua]]. That world was located within the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> and lay on the junction of four [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] called the [[Oktos Route]], the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']], the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']], and the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']].<ref name="TEA" /> The stormy [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was devoid of any life forms until some point<ref name="Biogenesis" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> when microbial life was discovered in the satellite's seas.<ref name="Biogenesis" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
An individual who visited the moon at that [[Time/Legends|time]] in order to observe the process of biogenesis cautiously obtained a sample of the microbes and brought it back to a partner.<ref name="Biogenesis" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kiskua's moon was first mentioned in a Bionanalysis Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]] and released in [[2011]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Biogenesis" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Y'Toub [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Kiskua and its moon, in grid square S-12.<ref name="TEA" />
